purpose: Freeze one amount-path-efficiency factor, the complete 112-definition semantic library, all 110 eligible numeric comparisons, ordered no-return gates, and exactly one conditional 2019-2023 development trial before opening Campaign081 source rows or values.

candidate.name: intraday_amount_path_efficiency_238p
candidate.formula: x_i=log1p(amount_i); for each 120-bar half h, E_h=abs(x_last-x_first) and V_h=sum(abs(diff(x))) over 119 within-half transitions; score=(E_morning+E_afternoon)/(V_morning+V_afternoon)
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A smoothly migrating participation schedule can indicate coordinated multi-minute execution and persistent attention, potentially supporting three-session continuation more reliably than a choppy amount path with the same endpoints.
candidate.source_grid: Require exactly the raw 09:30 row plus all 240 standard continuous-session bars; select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 and exclude 09:30 from the factor.
candidate.transform: natural log1p applied independently to every finite nonnegative selected amount
candidate.endpoint_rule: For each half, take the absolute difference between its last and first transformed amount; add the two nonnegative displacements.
candidate.variation_rule: For each half, sum absolute adjacent differences of transformed amount; add the two nonnegative variations and exclude the lunch transition.
candidate.amount_rule: Every selected amount must be finite and nonnegative; exact zero is valid. No positive total-amount condition is imposed independently of the denominator rule.
candidate.denominator_rule: The pooled within-half total variation must be finite and strictly positive; exact zero is missing.
candidate.missing_semantics: Missing for invalid or duplicate source identity, any source-grid mismatch, any selected nonfinite or negative amount, nonfinite transformed path, nonfinite or nonpositive pooled total variation, or a nonfinite or out-of-range score. Never impute, smooth, clip, bucket, rank, winsorize, rescale, neutralize, or substitute another grid.
candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 numpy.log1p, numpy.diff, numpy.abs, and ordered axis-1 sums. Do not clip or canonicalize an out-of-range result; mark it missing and fail semantic validation if an eligible result is outside [0,1].
